description: This file defines the TabStopsRenderer class, which is responsible for rendering a collection of tab stops in a document to RTF format within the MigraDoc library. It includes logic for special handling of single decimal tab stops for backward compatibility and utilizes other renderer factory methods to process individual tab stops.

classes.name: TabStopsRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders a collection of tab stops to RTF format, inheriting from RendererBase, with logic for handling specific tab stop configurations for compatibility purposes.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Overrides the base Render method to output the tab stops to RTF, including special handling for single decimal tab stops to ensure consistent formatting.
